name: org-hats
description: A portable organizational authority subsystem — use-case authority runtime, signed access envelopes, and a verification-only access module. The v0.4 organization model lives at its tags.
author: Rick <rick@thinkpad>

scripts.test:tools: node --test tests/release-tools.test.ts tests/gate-cache.test.ts tests/artifact-check.test.ts tests/tooling-policy.test.ts tests/git-guards.test.ts tests/ci-run.test.ts
scripts.spec:integration: pnpm --filter org-hats-cloudflare exec vitest run $(bin/spec-suite integration --from packages/cloudflare)
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node bin/fix-dts.mjs
scripts.check:cloudflare: pnpm --filter org-hats-cloudflare typecheck && pnpm --filter org-hats-cloudflare test
